reviewed_replacements.before:
Crafting evidence integrated: Pendant Insight INT +7 retains its direct item-tooltip support. Chains Equipment Combustion +142 and Quality INT +3 are now source-supported recipe derivations: separate host, Legendary recipe and category-definition records, not invented finished-item tooltips. The 142 is a selected-gear Fire Spell Power contribution, not weapon damage, established imbue scaling, full-character Spell Power or DPS. The Intelligence total is still withheld: seven other inputs and the Pendant Insight–Chains Quality interaction remain unqualified. Chains Fortification and Spot remain excluded. No equipment, priorities, modeled amounts or stacking rules changed. Bounded integration record · New category evidence and remaining gaps · Original host and recipe captures.

Crafting evidence integrated: Pendant Insight INT +7 retains its direct item-tooltip support. Chains Equipment Combustion +142 and Quality INT +3 are now source-supported recipe derivations: separate host, Legendary recipe and category-definition records, not invented finished-item tooltips. The 142 is a selected-gear Fire Spell Power contribution, not weapon damage, established imbue scaling, full-character Spell Power or DPS. Seven additional INT definitions now have direct source support: Melancholic +15 Enhancement, Solar +4 Artifact, Lunar +4 Profane, Festive +2, Dimlight +2 Exceptional, Globe +1 Exceptional and native Celestial +2 Profane. All nine selected INT definitions qualify, but Globe INT +1 is suppressed by Dimlight +2 and Celestial INT +2 by Lunar +4. The combined Intelligence total is still withheld: ten cross-type interactions, including Pendant Insight–Chains Quality, remain unqualified. The model-only +37 is not a certified total. Chains Fortification and Spot remain excluded. No equipment, priorities, modeled amounts or stacking rules changed. Seven-INT integration and remaining gaps · New INT and historical Spot observations · Earlier bounded recipe integration · Original host and recipe captures.
